measurements.scope: External 2D silhouette; count is resolved crests per side, excluding partial end crests. Pitch is axial spacing of corresponding same-direction flanks at a fixed radial section. Trapezoidal radii are individual flank-to-land fillets, not circles across flat lands. Diameters interpolate opposing crest/root envelopes. Radius zero means a sharp observed polyline junction; unresolved radii are unavailable. No nominal thread standard or 3D lead is inferred.
